name: Old Age And Destitute Pension
benefit: ₹1500/- per month for Old Age Persons, Destitute women, Widows, and Transgender with age less than 60 years.₹2000/- per month for Old Age Persons, Destitute women, Widows, and Transgender with age between 60 years and 79 years.₹3000/- per month for Old Age Persons, Destitute women, Widows, and Transgender with age 80 years and above.
eligibility_rules: Old Age both men and Women above fifty-five years. Widows above 18 years of age. Deserted Women consecutively deserted for the past seven years. Unmarried Women above 40 years. Transgender above 21 years.
documents_required: Identification certificate. Income certificate ( Not Exceeding ₹75,000/
Residence certificate. Attested copy of Birth Certificate
or documentary proof of age. Attested copy of Ration Card/Identity Card. Attested copy of Aadhaar and Bank Pass Book. Attested copy of
the Death Certificate of the husband in case of Widow. In the case of deserted Women, a Certificate from the M.L.A. and Anganwadi
Worker, that the individual has been deserted for seven years consecutively and a sworn affidavit in Appendix I.In the case of unmarried
Women, and a sworn affidavit in Appendix II.In the Transgender, proof of being 40 years and above and a Medical Certificate from a
how_to_apply:
Mode: Offline Whom to ApplyPuducherry: The Deputy Director (Social Defence), Old Age Pension Section, Department of Women and Child Development, Puducherry. Karaikal: The Child Development Project Officer, Karaikal. Mahe/Yanam:
The Welfare Officer, Mahe/ Yanam. Processing TimeThe selection is periodical and depends on the vacancies and on the availability of funds. In case of delay whom to contact? Puducherry: The Director, Department of Women and Child Development, Sithankudi, Puducherry. Karaikal: The Collector, Karaikal. Mahe/Yanam: The Regional Administrator, Mahe/Yanam.
